prompt:
Draw an 8-FRAME SWORD ATTACK animation sprite sheet for a 2D game character, side profile facing RIGHT, arranged as ONE SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of 8 poses.

THE CHARACTER, identical in every frame: a lean athletic cyberpunk death god. A full-face bright red #E01F26 hannya oni mask covering the WHOLE head with narrow white glowing eye slits and a fanged white grin, two red horns swept BACKWARD. A very long ponytail banded deep indigo #1E33D9 at the root through electric blue #2B6FE8 to bright cyan #35C6F4 at the tip. A BROAD PURE WHITE sleeveless captain's haori with a torn ragged hem. A black tracksuit jacket with acid-green #C6F02A and cyan racing stripes, sleeves pushed to the elbows showing deep brown #855434 forearms. Black hakama trousers gathered at the ankles, black tabi boots. A wakizashi stays sheathed at his LEFT hip.

EIGHT FRAMES, a single continuous katana swing. The blade edge glows acid green #C6F02A:
1. ANTICIPATION: weight shifts back, katana drawing back beside the head, body coiling.
2. WINDUP PEAK: blade fully cocked behind the shoulder, torso rotated away, front foot lifting.
3. INITIATION: torso snaps forward, blade just beginning to travel, hair whipping.
4. SWING: blade sweeping through horizontally at chest height with a bright green arc trail.
5. IMPACT: full extension, front knee deeply bent in a lunge, blade at maximum reach, the green arc at its widest.
6. FOLLOW THROUGH: blade continuing past the target, arc thinning and breaking up.
7. RECOVERY: blade lowering, body beginning to straighten, haori settling.
8. RESET: back to a balanced ready stance, blade held low, cloth still settling.

Every frame the SAME SIZE, SAME SCALE, aligned to the SAME invisible ground line.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.

LAYOUT: PURE BLACK background (#000000). ONE horizontal row, wide empty black gutters between poses. NO second row, NO grid lines, NO borders, NO ground lines, NO text, NO labels, NO dividing rules of any kind. Every pose complete and uncropped including the full sword arc.

STRICT PALETTE — ONLY: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568 #4A2A1A #855434 #B07A4A.

Draw an 8-FRAME JUMP AND FALL animation sprite sheet for a 2D game character, side profile facing RIGHT, arranged as ONE SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of 8 poses.

1. CROUCH: knees deeply bent, coiling down to launch, haori pooling.
2. LAUNCH: body explosively stretched tall and upward, arms down, hair whipped straight DOWN behind.

7. FALL FAST: legs trailing far behind, haori billowing UP hard, hair streaming straight up.
8. LANDING: knees deeply bent absorbing impact, haori collapsing down around him, hair dropping.

Draw an 8-FRAME IDLE BREATHING animation sprite sheet for a 2D game character, side profile facing RIGHT, arranged as ONE SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of 8 poses.

THE CHARACTER, identical in every frame: a lean athletic cyberpunk death god standing at rest. A full-face bright red #E01F26 hannya oni mask covering the WHOLE head with narrow white glowing eye slits and a fanged white grin, two red horns swept BACKWARD, a small cyan third eye on the forehead. A very long ponytail banded deep indigo #1E33D9 through electric blue #2B6FE8 to bright cyan #35C6F4 at the tip, hanging down behind him. A BROAD PURE WHITE sleeveless captain's haori with a torn ragged hem. A black tracksuit jacket with acid-green #C6F02A and cyan racing stripes, sleeves pushed to the elbows showing deep brown #855434 forearms. Black hakama trousers gathered at the ankles, black tabi boots. Katana and wakizashi SHEATHED at his LEFT hip, hands relaxed at his sides.

EIGHT FRAMES, a slow calm breathing loop that returns exactly to its start so it can repeat forever. The motion is SUBTLE — he is standing still, not moving around:
1. Neutral rest.
2. Chest beginning to rise, shoulders lifting very slightly.
3. Inhale continuing, body at mid-rise, ponytail tip drifting a beat behind.
4. Full inhale, chest at its highest, shoulders raised, haori lifted slightly.
5. Holding, the smallest settle beginning, ponytail catching up.
6. Exhale, chest lowering, shoulders dropping.
7. Exhale continuing, body settling toward rest, haori falling.
8. Almost back to neutral, ponytail giving one last small sway.

The body moves only a few pixels between frames. The ponytail and the ragged haori hem trail the body's motion so the cloth and hair feel alive.

Every frame the SAME SIZE, SAME SCALE, feet planted on the SAME invisible ground line.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.

LAYOUT: PURE BLACK background (#000000). ONE horizontal row, wide empty black gutters between poses. NO second row, NO grid lines, NO borders, NO ground lines, NO text, NO labels, NO dividing rules of any kind.
